requirement:
HC's issue-content implementation can cache a fetched issue snapshot with a
fetch time and an application-selected TTL. When caching is enabled, reads
within the TTL reuse that snapshot. After expiry, a network-enabled read obtains
a refreshed snapshot before returning contents, or reports a refresh failure.
The returned contents, formatter, and fingerprint remain based on the same
snapshot.
rationale:
No source carries a {test} reference to `requirements.sdk.habeas.github_nodes.cache`. A `references` lookup returned no sites. A search of `src` for TTL, fetch-time and snapshot terms found only the FIXME comment in `src/sdk.rs#enum[HabeasNode]` and unrelated "snapshot" uses. So the requirement's testable obligations have no tests:

- Reads within the TTL reuse the cached snapshot.
- After expiry, a network-enabled read refreshes the snapshot or reports a refresh failure.
- Returned contents, formatter and fingerprint all come from the same snapshot.

The gap is acknowledged. `src/sdk.rs#enum[HabeasNode]` carries a `{fixme}` on `requirements.sdk.habeas.github_nodes.cache`. It names nikomatsakis/habeas-codicem#26, which is open. Its body describes this same gap: tests do not yet cover reuse, expiry refresh/failure, or snapshot-consistent formatting and fingerprinting. I found no tests that would make the FIXME stale.
